stories.title: Dirt for the Triad
stories.summary: Esmerelda calls this ingredient an eastern hat. The Passage of Clarity explains the clue; deliver dirt for an emerald bracelet.

steps.text: Carry the small key for the hidden stairway

stories.title: Aid the Dying Witch
stories.summary: Bring the dying witch a small potion of healing. She gives a triangular bracelet and fades away. Her guidance toward the witches does not make the bracelet a required exchange ingredient.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small potion of healing
steps.hint: The doctor carries this specific potion. A valid potion supplied by another player works too; another healing potion with a similar name may not. Supplies received from another player are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver the healing potion to the dying witch
steps.hint: Bring the exact listed offering to the named giver. The recorded outcome is the exchange reward.

introduction: Breale hides a second world beneath its streets. Help a wounded witch, decipher the Passage of Clarity, and follow the Triad's reagent requests.
orientation: Explore with look and exits. Inspect inscriptions and numbered drawings; the Triad uses their east and west positions as ingredient clues.
Meet people to reveal their conversations and requests. Some townsfolk are hostile to shaman, sorcerer, necromancer, summoner, and conjurer classes.
Each accepted exchange has its own progress. Earlier deliveries and passwords provide guidance; valid supplied ingredients are accepted without that history.

contacts.name: Esmerelda
contacts.description: Her greeting introduces the Triad and the Passage of Clarity. Her fennel exchange points you toward Abigail.

contacts.name: Abigail
contacts.description: Brontella prompts her reagent clues. Her second mixture points you toward Pontif with the word montra.

contacts.name: Pontif
contacts.description: Montra prompts the final ingredient clues. The reward is the Triad amulet; the journal records this delivery.

contacts.name: the dying witch
contacts.description: Her wrist gesture and plea ask for a small potion of healing. The triangular bracelet is a reward and a narrative clue.
